messages:
maria (PartnerOps): Heads-up: CloudX marketplace + TitanHW joint promo going live tomorrow 10:00 PST. We need a SEV handshake and on-call handoff plan. Can ops + partner reps confirm who covers the war room?
ashok (Eng Oncall): I can be primary for Redwood side. Who's the partner oncall?
sophie (Partner Success): Pinged CloudX and TitanHW in DMs. Recommend a shared channel #partner-warroom-cloudx-titan for fast comms. Also propose a temporary bridge for voice.
marketplace-bot: Deployment scheduled: marketplace/cloudx/titan-promo v2 -> prod at 10:00 PST
tom (Eng): If we need a bridge I'll spin up a meeting + bridge link: https://zoom.redwood/abc123 — will post once ready.
jen (PartnerOps): Handoff checklist (short): ```1) Create shared channel + pinned runbook link
2) Assign primary + backup contacts
3) Post bridge link and escalation ladder
4) Monitor canary -> ramp -> prod, alert at 95th pct latency or error spike
5) If capacity >90% route to fallback model-quant variant```
leo (TitanHW SI): I'm TitanHW SI eng — I'll monitor telemetry and KV cache spike alerts. Please add @leo to the channel and give access to HW telemetry dashboards.
ashok (Eng Oncall): Added @leo. Primary oncall Redwood: @ashok. Backup: @tom. CloudX primary: @nina-cx, TitanHW primary: @leo.
nina-cx (CloudX PM): Got it. I'll join the channel and provide marketplace log access. Ownership contact: marketplace-ops@cloudx.com
maria (PartnerOps): Can we set an automatic fallback policy if dedicated capacity hits 90%? Suggest routing to quantized model variant to avoid latency SLO breach.
tom (Eng): I'll add a routing policy: `if gpu_util > 90% -> route to model-v2-quant` — will test in staging now.
jen (PartnerOps): War room doc: https://confluence.redwood/partner-warrooms/cloudx-titan-promo — please add runbook edits. I'll be on standby 09:30 PST.
marketplace-bot: Alert: canary traffic ramp at 09:45 PST: 5% -> 20%
ashok (Eng Oncall): :thumbsup: Confirmed. primary coverage 09:30-12:30 PST. Will escalate to #eng-sre if latency > 350ms.
maria (PartnerOps): Thanks all — channel created, bridge link posted to #partner-warroom-cloudx-titan and confluence updated. Tag me for any blocker. :rocket:
